entry.title: An access inside a call's arguments or result assignment stays refused: 9,539 leaves on 2,408 Unknown functions, 242 sole-blocked
entry.why: Card W43-INDIRECT-ACCESS-GENERAL admits only statements with no call (the typed scalar-access route is never consulted for a statement that carries one). Measured at its AFTER census (docs/reports/w43-indirect-access-general/residuals.txt, class call-argument): 9,539 leaves of the five access-refusal families in 2,408 Unknown functions, 242 of them blocked by that family alone. These are `f(p->x)`, `x = f(p->x)` and `p->f = g()`; the borrowed-actual, bound-read and member-address routes already admit narrow cases. Admitting one needs the call's own contract (and, for an uncontracted callee, the call leaf remains: the census-2 exchange proxy). DISCHARGE: a card that admits a typed scalar access in a Borrowed data argument or as a call result's scalar destination, with the call's existing obligations retained, and a measured re-pin; or a recorded decision that the class belongs to the call routes.

ground: Its discharge condition: "a card that admits a typed scalar access in a Borrowed data argument or as a call result's scalar destination, with the call's existing obligations retained, and a measured re-pin; or a recorded decision that the class belongs to the call routes". Card W44-INDIRECT-CALL-ARGUMENT-ACCESS admits typed reads (scalar values over typed scalar accesses, pointer reads through `T **` bases and pointer members, non-pointer sub-object addresses) at declared Borrowed positions and in declared variadic data tails of contracted calls, retaining every obligation of the call (the statement is classified again by the ordinary classifier) and adding the typed read's dereference obligation and a second obligation before it, with Lean parity in QCore.CallArgumentAccess and a measured re-pin (docs/reports/w44-indirect-call-argument-access/README.md). The uncontracted part is recorded as belonging to the call routes (W44-CALL-ARGUMENT-UNCONTRACTED); the call-result destination (`p->f = g()`) is re-registered, measured, as W44-CALL-RESULT-INDIRECT-DESTINATION; every other refused shape is re-registered narrower with its AFTER-census size.
